<cite ref="Moed Katan 27b:13">Ib.</cite> <he>לא ש׳ איכא במתא</he> is there not a dead (to be buried) in town (and they pursue their labors)? <cite ref="Bava Batra 91a:9">B. Bath. 91ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M01735"><he>מָנוֹבַיְיתָא</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>שִׁכְבֵּי</he>, <cite ref="U00069"><he>שִׁי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 48b:6">Ib. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ דהרפניא</he> the dead of Harpania (for whom the shrouds are not woven until they are dead); a. e.—V. <cite ref="U01144"><he>שָׁכִיב</he></cite>.
